title: A Framework for Critical Evaluation of Text-to-Image Models: Integrating Art Historical Analysis, Artistic Exploration, and Critical Prompt Engineering.
findings: The paper found that AI models exhibit a bias towards Western religious iconography, such as consistently generating images of Christian saints even when prompted for more general spiritual figures. In a case study involving 'The Arnolfini Portrait,' models struggled with depicting deep symbolic interpretations and often omitted crucial religious symbols present in the original artwork.
